response.sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(t.Milliseconds), 0) AS rate FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM rates) SELECT r.Name AS media_type_name, r.rate, r.rate - b.average_rate AS amount_above_average FROM rates AS r CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE r.rate > b.average_rate;

assumptions.assumption: A media type’s rate is total bytes divided by total milliseconds. Tracks with unknown bytes cannot contribute to that rate.

alternatives.interpretation: A media type’s rate is the average of its individual tracks’ bytes-per-millisecond rates.
alternatives.sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds <> 0 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM rates) SELECT r.Name AS media_type_name, r.rate, r.rate - b.average_rate AS amount_above_average FROM rates AS r CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE r.rate > b.average_rate;
